title: Using AI to port L2
author: RuloxTF
selftext:
Basically that! I am rebuilding the game in Godot so I can have a more modern engine, better textures and a better UI. The idea is to be as faithful as the original as possible (for example, the new UI and effects are optional, and you can turn them on/off on the client).

At the moment the client is limited but because I am reusing a L2J server, it is already multiplayer.

I think in a couple of months I will be able to allow for testers to get in and have a look!
